name: visible
summary: Is this element on screen, and has it ever been?

data-threshold.doc: How much of the element must show, 0 to 1; any of it by default.

data-margin.doc: Grows or shrinks the screen before the test, as CSS margin: "0px 0px -20% 0px".

visible.doc: On screen now; null until the observer first answers.

seen.doc: On screen at least once, and stays true; null until the first answer, so not-yet-known never reads as unseen.
